title: Spatio-Temporal Microclimate Prediction using Deep Learning
summary: Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering is developing a Vision Transformer model to predict local microclimates for urban design, heat-risk management and irrigation.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The project comes from Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering in India, which describes a Vision Transformer prototype in academic use on a college campus. The team describes deep-learning prediction of local climate conditions. The proposed benefits include better planning and thermal comfort. No source documents a change in an implemented service or intervention. Additional locations, seasons, model development, and external validation are planned. The paper that the International Telecommunication Union entry names as its pilot is a 2024 study by a National University of Singapore team on a different model. By October 2026, the code repository that the entry names was not public, and no later report of results had appeared.
purpose: Provide detailed microclimate information for planning and resource management.
system: Spatio-Temporal Microclimate Prediction using Deep Learning
developer: Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering

ratings.reason: The team reports a research model. Validation with urban authorities and agricultural technology firms is still planned.
Thermal comfort and reduced heat-related health risks are intended uses of the forecasts, with no outcome measurement.
Urban heat mitigation and resource savings remain proposed downstream uses.
